title: Dynamics GP Migration Prerequisites for Business Central

facts.text: Customer has Business Central online tenant.
At least one user has SUPER permission set in target company.
Dynamics GP migration retains existing Business Central user permissions; users not automatically reassigned to Intelligent Cloud.
Install Intelligent Cloud Base, Dynamics GP Intelligent Cloud, Dynamics GP Intelligent Cloud US, and Dynamics GP History SmartLists apps.
Supported for United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia markets only.
SQL Server 2016 SP1 or later with compatibility level 130 or higher.
Login account must have sysadmin role at server level and db_owner role at database level.
